![UML Diagram](./assets/UML_V2.png)

Relational Schema

Airlines(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
IataCode: VARCHAR(10),  
DotId: INT,  
Name: VARCHAR(100)  
)

States(  
StateCode: VARCHAR(10) \[PK\],  
StateName: VARCHAR(100)  
)

Cities(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
Name: VARCHAR(100),  
StateCode: VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL \[FK to States.StateCode\]  
)

Markets(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
SourceMarketId: INT,  
Name: VARCHAR(100),  
StateCode: VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL \[FK to States.StateCode\],  
Source: VARCHAR(100),  
IsMetroArea: BOOLEAN  
)

Airports(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
IataCode: VARCHAR(10),  
Name: VARCHAR(100),  
Longitude: DECIMAL(9,6),  
Latitude: DECIMAL(9,6),  
Datasource: VARCHAR(100),  
TimeZone: VARCHAR(100),  
CityId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Cities.Id\]  
)

AirportMarkets(  
AirportId: INT \[PK, FK to Airports.Id\],  
MarketId: INT \[PK, FK to Markets.Id\],  
Source: VARCHAR(100)  
)

Routes(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
OriginAirportId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Airports.Id\],  
DestinationAirportId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Airports.Id\],  
DistanceMiles: INT  
)

FlightRecords(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
Year: INT,  
Month: INT,  
Day: INT,  
DayOfWeek: INT,  
RouteId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Routes.Id\],  
MarketingAirlineId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Airlines.Id\],  
MarketingFlightNumber: VARCHAR(20),  
OperatingAirlineId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Airlines.Id\],  
OperatingFlightNumber: VARCHAR(20),  
TailNumber: VARCHAR(20),  
ScheduledDeptTime: VARCHAR(10),  
ActualDeptTime: VARCHAR(10),  
DeptDelayMinutes: INT,  
ArrDelayMinutes: INT,  
ActualArrTime: VARCHAR(10),  
ScheduledArrTime: VARCHAR(10),  
Cancelled: BOOLEAN,  
Diverted: BOOLEAN,  
ScheduledElapsedTimeMinutes: INT,  
ActualElapsedTimeMinutes: INT  
)

DelayCauses(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
Code: VARCHAR(20),  
Name: VARCHAR(100),  
Description: VARCHAR(255)  
)

FlightDelayCause(  
FlightRecordId: INT \[PK, FK to FlightRecords.Id\],  
DelayCauseId: INT \[PK, FK to DelayCauses.Id\],  
DelayMinutes: INT  
)

AirfareMarkets(  
Year: INT \[PK\],  
Quarter: INT \[PK\],  
OriginMarketId: INT \[PK, FK to Markets.Id\],  
DestMarketId: INT \[PK, FK to Markets.Id\],  
AverageFare: DECIMAL(10,2),  
LowestAirlineFare: DECIMAL(10,2),  
LowestFareAirlineId: INT \[FK to Airlines.Id\]  
)

Users(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
UserName: VARCHAR(100),  
Email: VARCHAR(100),  
PasswordHash: VARCHAR(255),  
CreatedTimestamp: DATETIME,  
UpdatedTimestamp: DATETIME  
)

SavedRoutes(  
Id: INT \[PK\],  
UserId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Users.Id\],  
RouteId: INT NOT NULL \[FK to Routes.Id\],  
Name: VARCHAR(100),  
Note: VARCHAR(255),  
UpdatedTimestamp: DATETIME,  
CreatedTimestamp: DATETIME  
)
